name: Skillveri Kelvin Lite: HVAC VR Training
summary:
Step into the future of training with Skillveri Kelvin Lite, the ultimate VR simulation for aspiring HVAC technicians. This "Lite" version offers a powerful, hands-on preview of the essential skills required to service modern heating and cooling systems.

Forget watching videos - start doing. Using Skillveri’s advanced hand-tracking technology, you can interact with tools and turn the valves naturally with your hands, just as you would in the field - no controllers needed!
